lines.en: So-
It appears that, thankfully, the last reset did not bring with it the reckoning of all of my new students.
In fact, we were able to make it through the day with almost near perfect attendance.
The only exceptions to that being the usual Yumi and Ayane who, after talking to Ami about it, wanted to take the day off for...mental health reasons or something like that.
I don’t know. The type of excuse or reason or whatever you want to call it doesn’t really matter to me because, as I’m sure you know-
I am incredibly bad at my job.
: Makoto.
: Hm? What is it?
: Thanks for all that you do.
: Wait, what?
: Did I hear that correctly?
: Did you...actually just thank me for something?
: Have I not done that before?
: Not as spontaneously as that...
: You’re not sick, are you?
: I’m very sick.
: Lovesick.
: I’m sorry.
: It’s okay.
: And you’re welcome.
: Though, I do wish you’d start applying some of the knowledge I know you have buried in that head of yours to-
: Oh, look. Ami and friends.
I cordially finish my conversation with Makoto and she accepts wholeheartedly that she is now the full time teacher of the classroom.
: Thank you for only addressing me by name and leaving these other girls to rot.
: That’s not really what-
: Sensei! Guess what?
: What, Noriko?
: I love you.
: Oh please.
: And also that we’re going to be visiting Ayane today and wanted to know if you wanted to come.
: Was the love part really necessary, then?
: No. But I felt it bubbling up inside and if I didn’t get it out I probably would have started screaming or something.
: I understand what you mean...but if you say it again, I will end you.
: Overwhelming feelings for me aside, I thought Ayane was just taking a “mental health day,” whatever that means.
: You should probably know what it means. I’m pretty sure you could use a few of those yourself.
: Nonsense. Sensei is in perfect mental health and everything he’ll ever need comes in a tiny package called Ami.
: Or the more deluxe version called Noriko.
: You’re not deluxe just because you're really pretty and...have really nice skin!
: And a famous sister who may or may not sing my favorite song!
: And really nice skin!
: Shut up! I hate you!
: Does it get exhausting having to deal with things like this all the time?
: Nope. This is my life now and I accept all of it.
: Yippee.
: Anyway, are you coming with us or not?
: Why are you even going?
: What do you mean “Why am I going?”
: I mean that if you’re just looking to torment Ayane, which you really shouldn’t, going to her room to do it might be a little too harsh for even you.
: The fuck do you mean “even me?”
: I’m pretty sure you know exactly what I mean, Kirin.
: No, Sensei. Please explain my relationship with Ayane to me because you seem to completely understand it while I don’t.
: Uhh...everything okay?
: Yes. And Sensei obviously isn’t coming, so let’s just go now.
: If there’s anything that’s sure to cheer up Ayane, it’s seeing her favorite man in the whole wide world showing up at her door with a bunch of really close friends.
: I didn’t realize Noriko and Ayane were “close friends.”
: I’d say we’re more like comrades in arms. We can bond over our shared interest in one day marrying you.
: If anyone is marrying Sensei it’s me! I’m his [niece], so I deserve it!
: Are you really going to just let her yell something like that?
: I’ve learned by now that I don’t really have a choice.
: But, either way, I think I’ll sit this one out.
: You’re...really not coming?
: You’re worried about her too, aren’t you?
: Of course. But I think Ayane might just want to be left alone right now.
: I know if I was trying to fix my mental health, the last thing I’d want is a bunch of people showing up at my door and trying to force me to feel better.
: You’re not really like everybody else, though. What Ayane wants might be a little different.
I don’t think it is.
I still don’t fully understand what’s been going through her head lately, but I do think I’ve come to learn just what it is that can make her feel better.
Apart from my penis, of course.
And that’s to wallow in her own self-doubt until it dissipates and becomes easier to ignore.
These three will fail miserably today.
: Anyway, tell Ayane that I hope she feels better soon.
: Class is eerily quiet without her.
: Of course.
: And if there’s anything else you’d like me to give her in your absence, please do tell.
: Like maybe a big old banana or something else that would remind her of you.
: Ayane does love bananas.
: I...think Kirin may have been insinuating something else.
: Bananas are a good source of potassium.
: Very good, Ami. Thank you for paying attention to Makoto’s lecture on nutrients earlier today.
: Does potassium make girls feel better when they’re sad?
: Not really. But it does help take some of the pain away.
: Uhh...Anyway, I guess the three of us will just start heading over to the dorms.
: What are you going to do in the meantime?
: Probably try to go home and then get stopped by another one of you girls on the way.
: Well, whoever it is, make sure that you tell them you’re off limits and that you’ll be too busy thinking of me to pay any attention to them today.
: Or any day.
: I love you so much.
: Hooray. Now I want to puke.
Ami, Kirin, and Noriko exit the classroom. And since the day has already come to an end, the rest of the girls begin to filter out as well.
I decided earlier that everyone is completely okay mentally and that it’s fine for me to skip my office hours every once in a while, so I quickly make my way downstairs and begin to head home.
Fortunately, I’m able to make it to the lockers without being spotted by-
: Stop right there, mister!
Damn it.
: This better be you finally accepting my marriage proposal, Uta.
: Careful, Sensei! If Ami hears you, she’ll chop both of our heads off and make hamburger meat out of them!
: Oh, right. I’m supposed to tell you that I’m only going to think about her today.
: Even if I come to you today with a once in a lifetime opportunity to see me in less clothing than normal?
: Wait, who is Ami again?
: That’s the Sensei I know!
: Now, get on over here and listen to my proposition!
I turn fully around to find that Futaba is here as well, but had been lingering off to the side to avoid being embarrassed by Uta’s entrepreneurial “hook.”
The three of us agree to have a threesome and quickly make our way back to-
: Now before you go gettin’ all rock hard on us, I wanna make it clear this isn’t a sexual thingy.
: That’s a detail you should have informed me of before I stopped walking.
: Hey now. Just cause it won’t be sexual doesn’t mean you won’t still have a good time!
: Are you sure about that?
: Um...can we maybe not...talk about things like this in the hallway?
: It might attract...unnecessary attention.
: What’s goin’ on? I came runnin’ when I heard the naughty talk and had a feeling that Sensei was gonna be involved somehow.
: Well, it was certainly a good hunch, Miku. But I don’t know if whatever Uta’s plan is will work with four people.
: Actually, Miku being here makes things even better! We can hit all three food groups at once!
: Food groups? You three goin’ out to eat or somethin’?!
: Can I come?!
: Food groups as in boobies, Miku.
: We’ve got the voluptuous beauty, the short stack, and now the washboard!
: Umm...Uta?...
: Miku is a little self conscious about-
: I’ll fuckin’ kill you! You think you’re so great because of those friggin’ fat bags on your chest!
: Just wait until they’re draggin’ across the ground in twenty years, damn it! Then you’ll be beggin’ to be me!
: ...her chest.
: There’s nothing to be self conscious about, Miku. I personally love all boobies and I’m sure that Sensei is in the same boat.
: Confirmed.
: Still doesn’t really explain why you’re gathered in the hall talkin’ about it...
: Because Uta hasn’t...really gotten to the whole reason for this yet.
: I was gettin’ there when our latest participant showed up.
: Sensei! Futaba and I were gonna go to the mall to try on new swimsuits for the beach! Do you have any idea what this means?
: That you’re likely going to develop hypothermia sometime in the near future.
: Possibly! But also that we need the judgement of a lecher like yourself to know if we’re cute or not!
: Well...I do kinda want a new swimsuit.
: I like my one piece and stuff...but it kinda takes away a lot of the fun of the water if I can’t feel wet all over, ya know?
: Please...watch the way you word things, Miku...
: Hm? There somethin’ wrong with bein’ all wet?
: You can’t possibly turn this down now, can you?
: Oh, I’ve been aboard since the whole “less clothing” thing. I just wanted to see if this conversation would go anywhere exciting.
: I was not let down.
: How is getting wet naughty?! It’s totally natural!
: That it is, Miku.
: That it is...
The four of us leave the[school] together and I’m forced to basically jog alongside all of them in order to make it to the bus stop on time.
And when I say “jog” I basically mean speed walk...but I consider pretty much everything faster than walking as some form of running because I hate all of them and want no part of any.
Either way, we manage to make it to the bus stop right as the bus gets there and the speed-jog-running pays off in saving us a grand total of maybe thirty minutes overall.
I don’t know. The bus schedules around here are kind of all over the place.
But we get on board and begin making our way to the mall.
Uta sits next to me while Miku and Futaba take their spot on a three-seater opposite us.
I feel a little bad for Futaba as she has to deal with the brunt of Miku’s verbal chest-related abuse but, at the very least, it seems like she’s already used to it.
: Psst...Sensei...
Needless to say, the girls decide to buy the swimsuits and then stash their bags in some nearby coin operated lockers.
And, in other news, I once again make a monumental change in their lives simply by having a penis and being around them.
Life is good when you are me.
: So, what do you wanna do now?
: It didn’t really take that long to choose our swimsuits and stuff, and I don’t have to work tonight so-
: Woah! What are you doin’ here?!
: Huh?
: Do you know her, Miku?
: She looks...kind of familiar.
: Well, well, well...
: If it isn’t my favorite teacher...out and about with a bunch of[school] girls.
: Do I need to notify the board of education about this?
: Please don’t. They will not approve.
: Maki! I wore a bikini for the first time and only hated myself a little bit!
: Case in point.
: You shouldn’t hate yourself at all, Miku.
: You may not be as grown up as someone like me just yet, but the amount of energy you have and your tomboyish charm would still make for some really alluring scenes in-
: Okay, stop right there Maki. There’s no need to-
: Wait, why am I suddenly being the mature one?
: Futaba. Back me up on this so I can return to being me.
: Huh?...Oh! Sorry...I’m just trying to figure out who she reminds me of...
: Maki Miyamura. I’m Makoto’s mother.
: Oh! That’s it!
: It’s so nice to meet you. I’m Futaba, a classmate of hers.
: And you? With the surprisingly nice rack?
: Uta Ushibori. It’s nice to meet you.
: You really lucked out with this class, huh?
: Sensei’s a hot commodity and has tons of girls just throwin’ themselves at him!
: It’s crazy he hasn’t been fired yet!
: That just means he’s doing his part as a responsible adult and not acting inappropriately toward girls out of his age group.
: Correct me if I’m wrong, but I distinctly remember Nodoka and you having an in-depth conversation about anal sex at the bar recently.
: Heh. You used “in-depth” and “anal” in the same sentence.
: I...suppose Makoto inherited only her mother’s looks and not her personality.
: Are you free right now, by any chance?
: I...think so?
: I came here to-
: Watch us strip!
: Help you choose clothing. But now that it’s done, I think I have some time to spare.
: Perfect. Because I’ve actually been wanting to talk to you about something lately and this seems like too good of an opportunity to just let it slip.
: Heh. Slip. Like from being wet.
: Ah! I get it now! That’s the kinda wetness you guys were sayin’ is dirty!
: I’m gonna have to wash my mouth out, aren’t I?!
Maki quickly whisks me away and the two of us part ways with the girls I came here with.
I feel a little rude about leaving them behind just as it seemed that Uta was about to try and make new plans-
But I see all of them basically every day.
And, like Maki said, this opportunity seemed too good to just let slip.
: Uta? You comin’ with us? Or are you just gonna stand there like a weirdo?
: Oh! Hahah!
: Must’a zoned out for a second!
: What do you guys wanna do now?
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
: You’re not gonna try and sneak into our dressing rooms, are you?
: Probably not. I imagine I look strange enough accompanying three girls in[school] uniforms to the mall.
: But you want to, right?
: Yes.
: Are you really that perverted?
: Yes.
: I’m...having a hard time remembering why I agreed to this.
: Um...don’t go expectin’ too much, okay? It’s embarrassin’ enough havin’ to be seen next to these two overinflated bimbos.
: Are you excited, Sensei? Does this get your blood pumping?
: Uta, just to clarify, are you trying to turn me on right now?
: Me? Uta Ushibori? Trying to get my teacher riled up? Do you really think I would do something like that?
: I don’t really know how else to interpret this strange level of assertion you have today.
: Maybe I just really like the beach?
: I’ll tell ya what. If you agree to not go peepin’ on me, I won’t tell anyone if you decide to peep on either of them. How does that sound?
: Bad...
: We can hear you...
: I like ya a lot, Sensei...but even I wouldn’t want ya watchin’ me try on a new swimsuit.
: I don’t even know if it’ll fit yet.
: She says, as if she’s grown at all since she was a little kid.
: WELL SORRY WE’RE NOT ALL LUCKY ENOUGH TO GET FRIGGIN’ TRIPLE F’S BEFORE WE’RE EVEN FIVE FEET TALL.
: Those aren’t actually-
: Nope.
: I didn’t think so.
: I’m...going to get changed now.
: Me too! And I hope I don’t need assistance since I’m apparently still just a kid!
: If you do, you know where to-
: Shut up!
Miku and Futaba disappear behind the curtains and I’m left alone and totally clothed with Uta.
: Are you not going to follow them?
: Really don’t peek, okay?
: After all of that you’re really not going to let me?
: Not without my parents’ permission.
Uta joins Futaba in her dressing room, immediately prompting a gasp as I’m sure Futaba thought it was me sneaking in or something like that.
The three girls then proceed to spend an alarming amount of time inside, which is quite strange to me considering that they’re only trying on swimsuits.
But I guess I did see them grab a fair amount of them before going in and-
You know what?
I don’t really care how long I have to wait now that I think of it.
Because if I’m fortunate enough to watch these three expose themselves to me in what would be commonly cited as the most tame form of exhibitionism possible, time does not matter.
All that matters is swimsuits.
Swimsuits that may or may not lead to several of my students falling ill and dying in the very near future.
I will make sure to etch the images of their bodies into my mind so I can properly remember them if that does actually happen.
I open my eyes several minutes later after hearing the curtains pulled back and realized that I must have died and gone to Heaven.
I feel a little upset that I didn’t get to say goodbye to everyone, but if this is what the afterlife brings, I apologize for any horrible things I may have said about god God throughout my life.
: I’m goin’ back in the dressing room.
: All three of you look great.
: Two and a half.
: We all know it’s the chest that makes a woman and I’m about as much of a woman as the bench I left my blazer on.
: That’s not true! You’re super cute, Miku! And what you don’t have in boobies, you make up for in abs!
: You...really think this looks okay on me?...
: I...wanted to keep the stripes because of what they say about them being slimming, but...
: I...wasn’t sure if I liked the...black and white or not.
: Like I said, it’s great.
: Now, everyone turn around and bend over so I can see the rest of the swimsuits for a more accurate judgement of them.
: You actually a butt guy after all, Sensei? Or are you just tryin’ to make me feel better because I’ve actually got a little more to offer down there?
: Please be more embarrassed, Miku.
: Why? You see my legs all the time at soccer practice. You’d probably be able to choose my butt out of a police lineup if ya had to.
I don’t yet think I’m at that level of familiarity with Miku’s ass, but I would be lying if I said I did not want to be.
: So...we all set then? None of us look weird or ugly or anything?
: Not at all. Though, I’m a little surprised that you seem to be the most embarrassed out of everyone, Uta.
: Hm? What are you talkin’ about? I’m not embarrassed at all.
: Your face is really...flushed right now.
: Yeah. You’re in full-on tomato mode.
: It...was hot in the dressing room!
: And there were two of us, so...it was even hotter than it was supposed to be!
: I’m totally fine! And I’m glad you think we’re all totally fine as well, Sensei!
: Don’t mention it...
: So, girls! Are we ready to empty our wallets into the cash register in the name of looking cute?!
: As long as Sensei thinks I don’t look silly...
: You really don’t think somethin’ like this is a little too girly for me?
: Of course not. You’re a girl.
: Yeah, but...it’s not really my style...
: Just buy the fucking swimsuits already. You’re all adorable.
